$comment: NFR-04 recorded position: median ratio (ours / baseline library) over several runs. This file is a RECORD FOR REVIEWERS, NOT the gate input — the gate enforces a fixed floor on the ratio, so it neither depends on this file nor drifts with it. `observedSpread` shows the per-run min..max, i.e. how noisy each comparison inherently is; those spreads are exactly why the gate is a floor rather than a diff (ADR-0014). Refresh with `pnpm bench:baseline` when performance legitimately changes.

deepMerge vs lodash.merge — array-heavy.notEnforcedBecause: the ratio reflects a semantic difference (we replace arrays, lodash merges element-wise), not speed (ADR-0013)

parallelLimit settle mode — no baseline.notEnforcedBecause: no baseline library — absolute throughput is machine-dependent

retry — two transient failures, zero bac.notEnforcedBecause: the only comparison whose true value is GENUINE PARITY (~1.0), so it sits at the floor rather than far above it; its timer-bound ±10% swing therefore can and does cross 0.9 (observed 0.85). Parity here is real and verified by the 7.1 suite — it simply cannot be gated at a 10% tolerance (ADR-0013, ADR-0014)
